list.label: app
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT app FROM metrics.metrics ORDER BY app
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT app FROM metrics.metrics ORDER BY app

panels.title: Messages / s

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, concat(app, ' ', labels['kind']) AS series, sum(delta) / $__interval_s AS rate FROM metrics.metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'messages' AND app IN (${app:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.description: Counter deltas: each interval's increase, summed across cells and divided by the bucket's seconds.

panels.title: Spread (bps)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, labels['instrument'] AS instrument, avg(value) AS bps FROM metrics.metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'spread_bps' AND app IN (${app:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, instrument ORDER BY time

panels.description: A gauge: the last value set before each interval ended.

panels.title: Venue to us, min, p50, p99, p99.99, max (ms) (weighted window estimates)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, concat(app, ' ', labels['kind']) AS series, min(min) / 1e6 AS min, sum(p50 * count) / sum(count) / 1e6 AS avg_window_p50, sum(p99 * count) / sum(count) / 1e6 AS avg_window_p99, sum(p9999 * count) / sum(count) / 1e6 AS avg_window_p99_99, max(max) / 1e6 AS max FROM metrics.metrics_histogram WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'venue_to_local_ns' AND app IN (${app:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.description: Count-weighted averages of estimated percentiles from individual 5 s windows. These are not combined percentiles of all samples. Percentiles come from an HdrHistogram filled with each millisecond's min, max, and the mean of the rest. Exact min and max are columns. A busy millisecond pulls percentiles toward that mean. Zero when the venue's clock is ahead of ours (see Clamped).

panels.title: record() min, p50, p99, p99.99, max (µs) (weighted window estimates)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, app, min(min) / 1e3 AS min, sum(p50 * count) / sum(count) / 1e3 AS avg_window_p50, sum(p99 * count) / sum(count) / 1e3 AS avg_window_p99, sum(p9999 * count) / sum(count) / 1e3 AS avg_window_p99_99, max(max) / 1e3 AS max FROM metrics.metrics_histogram WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'record_ns' AND app IN (${app:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, app ORDER BY time

panels.description: Count-weighted averages of estimated percentiles from individual 5 s windows. These are not combined percentiles of all samples.

panels.title: record() estimated latency distribution (last interval)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ['min','p50','p75','p90','p99','p99.9','p99.99','p99.999','max'][idx] AS quantile, [toFloat64(min), p50, p75, p90, p99, p999, p9999, p99999, toFloat64(max)][idx] AS ns FROM (SELECT min, p50, p75, p90, p99, p999, p9999, p99999, max FROM metrics.metrics_histogram WHERE name = 'record_ns' AND app IN (${app:singlequote}) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) ARRAY JOIN range(1, 10) AS idx

panels.description: Percentiles reconstructed from millisecond count/sum/min/max summaries; the original distribution is not retained.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, concat(app, ' ', labels['reason']) AS series, sum(delta) / $__interval_s AS rate FROM metrics.metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'persist_dropped' GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.title: Clamped trace stages / s

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, concat(app, ' ', labels['trace'], ' ', labels['stage']) AS series, sum(delta) / $__interval_s AS rate FROM metrics.metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'trace_clamped' AND labels['stage'] != 'total' GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.description: Stages that ended before they began: the venue's clock is ahead of ours.

targets.rawSql: SELECT name, kind, app, pod, host, labels, argMax(value, ts) AS last FROM metrics.metrics WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL 1 MINUTE GROUP BY name, kind, app, pod, host, labels ORDER BY name, app
